watch.summary: The streamer quits a game he didn't enjoy, asking for his $6 back while browsing Steam for a new game.

beats.what: Streamer looks at the main menu of the game Meccha Chameleon.
Streamer states he wants his $6 back for the game.
Streamer quits the game to desktop.
Streamer opens Steam to look for a more palatable game to play.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I want my $6 back, you know.
watch.why: This is a casual stream transition where the creator gives a mild review after quitting a game. It lacks dynamic comedy beats or a strong punchline.
